_comment: Gate replay 2: quantized stem transition mid-replay (calm->combat at tick 120: boundary frame 192000 = bar 2, crossfade 9600), a set_state request while pending (tick 130, must be ignored), one ui cue over music, and a fade-to-silent tail (combat->silent at tick 300: boundary 288000, stem stopped 297600, float-exact silence after). Windows are 4800-frame Goertzel bins (10 Hz).
name: replay_music

ratio._transition_lands_at_boundary: stem_b ramps inside [192000,201600] - mid-fade amplitude ~1/3 of full; a bar-late landing would read ~0, a bar-early one ~1

silence._tail: stem_b stopped at 297600; the bus graph renders float-exact silence

peak._headroom_policy: whole render under -1 dBFS sample peak
